proof_requests: Photo of the disc itself (front and back) and close-up of any scratches/marks.
Video of the game launching on a PS4 (to confirm it reads and reaches the main menu).
Photos of the back cover and the inside inserts/pads to confirm what’s included.
Photo of the receipt (or at least a clear scan) if you want the “UK receipt” included in value.
response.reason: The item identity (PS4 Watch Dogs Legion) is clear from the photo, but key value drivers—disc condition/working status and included items—are not verifiable remotely from a single front-cover image. To price safely, I need proof the disc reads and what’s included.
